crossRefs.note: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for Yahweh shall inherit the land.
But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
Yahweh knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.
Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.
to love Yahweh your God, to obey his voice, and to cling to him; for he is your life, and the length of your days, that…
For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it.
But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.
I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying, “Behold, God’s dwelling is with people, and he will dwell with them, and…
He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor…
He who overcomes, I will give him these things. I will be his God, and he will be my son.

translations.web: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.
translations.bsb: The righteous will inherit the land and dwell in it forever.
translations.kjv: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.
translations.asv: The righteous shall inherit the land, And dwell therein for ever.
